body:
## Central-step checkpoint — 22 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This pass attacked the surviving ordinary escape contribution and the missing universal source-to-target return. It establishes an exact moving-cutoff boundary formula, controls the actual centered stopping clock, and refutes one proposed rational-shadow completion. The arithmetic lower estimate that would eliminate escape was not proved. Nontrivial cycles remain a separate obligation.

### 1. Exact boundary profile at every moving inverse cutoff

For an actual forward root \(q_k=U^k x\) in a hypothetical escaping component, let \(R_M\) be the finite canonical inverse Green potential, \(C_C\) the component capacity, and \(\Phi_x(s)\) the original canonical charge above relative clock \(-s\). The new written proof gives

$$
\sup_{M\ge0}\left|R_M(q_k)-\frac{\Phi_x(M-k)}{C_C}\right|\longrightarrow0.
$$

The error is uniform over all cutoffs, including an adaptive choice. A corresponding formula retains the whole original finite source measure.

The two adjacent offsets identify the exact canonical finite-Green energy defect:

$$
\lim_{M\to\infty}\mathcal D(R-R_M)=E_{\rm sync},\qquad
\lim_{M\to\infty}\mathcal D(R_M)=\mathcal D(R)+E_{\rm sync},
$$

where
$$
E_{\rm sync}=\sum_{C\ {\rm escaping}}\frac1{C_C}
\sum_{r\in\mathbb Z}\left(\sum_{h_C(n)=r}d(n)\right)^2.
$$

Actual synchronous collisions are summed before squaring. This is a new explicit Green corollary of the pinned canonical construction and boundary identity. PR183's existing Wold interpretation is credited. The theorem identifies the possible nonzero term; it does not establish that the term vanishes.

**Evidence:** source-qualified written proof, independently reviewed. The infinite statement is not a Lean theorem.

[Proof and closing attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a9f471543d7fed0a76f348e6d97a9d6d44fa369e/research/central-step-20261122/CRITICAL_BOUNDARY.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/a9f471543d7fed0a76f348e6d97a9d6d44fa369e/research/central-step-20261122/REVIEW_BOUNDARY.md)

### 2. Actual excess-clock harmonicization

At a genuine inverse contact endpoint \(z\) of \(U^k p\), the exact centered clock is
\(\tau-k=h_C(p)-h_C(z)\).
One finite measure on original labels and endpoints makes its positive tail uniformly small. Bounded stopping then gives

$$
\lim_{R\to\infty}\sup_{k\ge0}
\sum_{n\ {\rm retained}}n^{-4}
\left(\frac{P^{k+R}V(U^k p_n)}{G(U^k p_n)}-1\right)=0.
$$

This uses the established monotone family \(P^mV\downarrow G\). It does not assume pointwise convergence of the finite densities at ordinary integers. The attempted closing implication fails because total inverse depth grows with the forward clock, while the existing whole-ancestor finite-density horizon is fixed by the component minimum. Increasing that floor restores the removed source as boundary immigration.

**Evidence:** source-qualified written proof, independently reviewed.

### 3. Direct arithmetic attack and the exact unresolved estimate

The actual siblings \(B(n)=64n+21\) satisfy \(U(Bn)=U(n)\). A hypothetical escape has a persistent linear spike \(G(q_k)\ge\eta q_k\), but finite total relative sibling current

$$
\sum_k\mathscr L_G(q_k)<\infty,\qquad
\mathscr L_G(n)=\sum_{j\ge1}64^{-j}\frac{G(B^j n)}{G(n)}.
$$

A lower bound \(\mathscr L_G(n)\ge c_\eta/\log(2+n)\) on sufficiently large persistent spikes would contradict that finite budget directly. Section 6 of the boundary note gives a sufficient fully finite obstacle formulation, OPEN-F. **Neither comparison was proved.**

The attempted identical-word transfer has an exact cost: a copied inverse word of depth \(r\) first becomes integral at sibling index \(j=3^{r-1}\), with height factor \(64^{3^{r-1}}\). Adaptive valuation repairs need a much lower weighted cost. Finite rare-cylinder diagnostics do not refute the high-linear comparison; the required ordinary-size constraint is retained.

The source lane also found an exact rational-shadow obstruction. For

$$
x=-6005/2187,\qquad y=8x+19=-6487/2187,
$$

the source reaches 1 with gaps \([2,2,2,2,2,2,1]\), and every accelerated source-prefix coefficient contracts. The target enters the negative cycle \(-7,-10,-5\), and every positive ordinary target-prefix coefficient expands. Thus the proposed coefficient-only rational-shadow bridge is false. This is not a positive-integer counterexample or a complete positive bounded-four source lift.

- The formal scope is the actual sibling family, identical-word obstruction, finite pair-clock identity, and the rational shadow's finite entry plus all-time coefficient statements. The infinite analytic results remain written deductions.
